title: Under-Seasoned Middle Eastern Oatmeal Tabbouleh Salad
description: A refreshing Middle Eastern-inspired salad to cure a hangover, featuring under-seasoned oatmeal, bulgur, and herbs. Perfect for a spring morning.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 2 cups of water to a boil over high heat.
Add 1/4 cup of bulgur and a pinch of salt. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine cooked bulgur, 1 cup of rolled oats, 1/4 cup of chopped scallions, 1/4 cup of grated carrot, and 1/4 cup each of chopped parsley and mint.
In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons of pomegranate molasses, 2 tablespoons of olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the bulgur mixture and toss to combine.
Serve warm, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
Note: This salad is intentionally under-seasoned to allow for individual taste preferences.
